topic: Task assignment and feature development planning
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on assigning tasks to a team member and planning feature development. The primary goal is to push through the release of new designs, specifically related to two Jira tickets (JCDEC-714 and JCDEC-715). Tasks include updating the Inventory details component with data from the Environment Tree list, fixing bugs in admin/other tabs upon initial opening, and implementing a map table feature. The team member will work on these tasks sequentially.

Separately, there were discussions regarding system administration needs, specifically the inability to add roles for their organization within Jira, which requires creating a task. Future development includes adding coordinates to frames and tracking changes when saving inventory data. A new concept discussed was the 'inner buffer' (visible zone around a board), which is reportedly provided by Google but raises questions about its availability in 3D data across all Brazilian cities. If necessary, this feature might require manually drawing polygons over many frames.
decisions: The team member will focus on completing and releasing the two specified design tickets (JCDEC-714 and JCDEC-715).
A task needs to be created in Jira to address the inability to add organization roles for administrators.
action_items: Create a Jira ticket regarding role management limitations.
Investigate the feasibility of implementing 'inner buffer' data, potentially requiring manual polygon drawing.
